description: The sum of the first n odd squares: 1^2 + 3^2 + ... + (2n-1)^2 = n(4n^2-1)/3. One term is 1, two terms are 10, and four terms are 84. n runs from 0 to 1000000. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/odd-square-sum
name: odd_square_sum
title: Odd Square Sum
